Please walk me through where things stand on your end.

transcript.text:
Thank you all for bringing these issues forward. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and what needs to happen before Thursday. We have four open items that must be reflected in the agreement:

First, privacy: Owen, I need you to circulate an updated data-use clause that (1) prohibits use of identifiable patient records for model training, and (2) requires Northstar to delete those records exactly 45 days after termination. Get that drafted and into the current revision today.

Second, finance: Maya, I need you to update the deal summary with your benchmark analysis confirming the 18% share of net receipts and quarterly audit right. Then we need to check the current draft's revenue-share provision against that benchmark and align it.

Third, export controls: Thomas, I need you to circulate the additional export provisions requiring (1) a prohibition on access by non-U.S. persons, and (2) a requirement that Northstar maintain an export-control compliance program. Get those added to the draft.

Fourth, conflicts: Grace, this is a significant flag. We need (1) Northstar's informed written consent to the conflict involving their parent company as an existing client in the patent matter, and (2) an ethical screen for the patent-matter team. Please begin the consent process immediately so we have executed documentation before Thursday.

I will withhold final approval of the agreement until all four items are reflected in the draft and the conflict consent is secured. Can each of you confirm you can complete your respective updates by end of day tomorrow so we have a clean draft for final review on Wednesday?
